_comment: Boss fights: crew = NPC kit the boss calls (empty = fights alone), signature = phase 3 move (rain_<look>, slash_line, black_hole, ground_wave), phase2/phase3 = what the boss shouts at 66% and 33% health. form = monster form the boss turns into at phase 2 (seiryu, leopard, pteranodon, venom_demon, brachiosaurus, gyuki), empty = none. Titans (Emperors, Admirals) also have mechanics = [phase 2 move, phase 3 move] (see TitanFight), phase4 = what they shout at 12% health, ultimate = moves joined by + fired big at phase 4, ultimateName = how it's announced.

queen.phase2: Murrrr! Time to get serious. Brachio form!
queen.phase3: Ice Oni Bullets! Catch the plague!

saturn.phase2: You still stand? Then see my true form.
saturn.phase4: Wounds mean nothing to me. I cannot die here.

blackbeard.phase2: Zehahaha! Now this is getting fun!
